locations.name: New York City Hall
locations.factShort: New York City Hall is the seat of New York City government, located at the center of City Hall Park in the Civic Center area of Lower Manhattan, between Broadway, Park Row, and Chambers Street.

locations.name: The City Reliquary
locations.factShort: The City Reliquary is a not-for-profit community museum and civic organization located in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. The museum traces the history of New York City's five boroughs with its exhibitions of cultural ephemera and relics.

locations.name: Gould Memorial Library
locations.factShort: The Gould Memorial Library (GML; also nicknamed Gould) is a building on the campus of Bronx Community College, an institution of the City University of New York, in University Heights, Bronx, New York City, United States. The building was designed by Stanford White of the firm McKim, Mead & White.

locations.name: Old St. Patrick's Cathedral
locations.factShort: The Basilica of Saint Patrick's Old Cathedral (sometimes shortened to St. Patrick's Old Cathedral or simply Old St. Patrick's) is a Catholic parish church, basilica, and former cathedral of the Archdiocese of New York, located in the Nolita neighborhood of Lower Manhattan, New York City.

locations.name: The Ear Inn
locations.factShort: The James Brown House is a historic building in the Hudson Square neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City. It was built in the late 18th century. Today, it is listed in the National Register of Historic Places and is a New York City designated landmark.
